confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vienna price levels; no live listings or city-price web searches were used. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine were set from approximate bar levels and cross-checked against the beer relationship. July hotel and hostel rates are least certain given peak-season and event-driven pricing. EUR examples were translated at a general working rate, so USD values will drift with currency moves.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Central and Western European capitals, judged from general knowledge; Vienna set above Prague and Budapest and close to Munich. No single city was copied.
